title: Perpetual Motion
description: Perpetual Motion is a Create mod-focused modpack that enhances Minecraft’s vanilla charm with deep automation possibilities, now with Aeronautics!
body:
Perpetual Motion is a modpack focused around Create & Create Aeronautics, that aims to provide a complete packaged experience. Various recipes and mods have been balanced to allow for the most creative automtion potential, while still being balanced for multiplayer. 

For lower end systems, It is recommended to disable the shaders that are enabled by default, and to disable tectonic, if playing on a singleplayer world.
